48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.38.10 - THE PHONES' CHANGES ARE KEPT; MEMBERS SEE NEW GROUPS AT ONCE (and Website Update 90)
  - Publish to the portal, Add the late arrivals, Make new groups and the round buttons first read the groups as they are now,
    so changes made on a phone a moment ago (swaps, someone taken out, notes) are kept. No need to Refresh first.
  - Members' portal (Website Update 90): new prayer groups appear at once, without opening the portal again; deleted ones
    disappear; someone added late sees their group at once.
